facts.text: Maria participated in a 5K charity run for a homeless shelter last weekend, which was described as having a special energy and sense of unity.

evidence.quote: Last weekend I did something new that had an impact on me. I participated in a 5K charity run for a homeless shelter. It was awesome being surrounded by people all there for the same cause. There's something special about the energy and sense of unity.
